logisticmatica.name: Logisticmatica
logisticmatica.gui.label.substitution.hi: Click a material to choose a replacement; click [x] to reset it.
logisticmatica.message.substitutions.no_: Focus a schematic first, then open substitutions.
logisticmatica.gui.button.menu.material_: Open the material list for the focused schematic.
logisticmatica.gui.button.menu.focus.hov: Choose which schematic or placement the HUD and lists follow.
logisticmatica.gui.button.menu.container: The tracked-container overview: what your marked chests hold, searchable.
logisticmatica.gui.button.menu.substitut: Swap materials in the focused schematic (e.g. spruce for oak).
All Logisticmatica options, hotkeys and colours.
logisticmatica.gui.button.menu.share.hov: Share placements with live sync, roles and server-tracked containers.
logisticmatica.config.hotkeys.comment.ma: Look at a container and press this to mark/unmark it as tracked. Marked containers' contents count towards the material list and are highlighted in the world.
logisticmatica.config.hotkeys.comment.op: Opens a picker for choosing what Logisticmatica focuses on: a placement (compared against the world, so it shows what is missing) or a loaded schematic (its total requirements). The focused material list is what the HUD and the list screen show.
Opens the tracked-container overview: every marked container and what it holds, searchable by item to answer "where is item X".
Opens the material-substitution editor for the focused schematic. Swaps are a non-destructive overlay: the ghost render, verifier and material list follow them, the .litematic file is never changed.
logisticmatica.config.hotkeys.comment.cy: Steps the material HUD to the next page when the list is longer than fits on screen.
logisticmatica.gui.label.focus.nothing_l: Nothing loaded. Load or place a schematic in Litematica first.
logisticmatica.gui.focus.kind.placement: Placement - missing blocks in this world
logisticmatica.config.colors.comment.col: Colour of the outline drawn around marked containers in the world.
logisticmatica.message.mark.no_focus: Focus a schematic first - marked containers are bound to one.
logisticmatica.message.mark.not_a_contai: That block is not a container.
logisticmatica.message.mark.marked: Container marked - its contents now count towards the list.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudEna: Master toggle for the Logisticmatica material HUD.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudRen: Also draw the HUD while a screen/menu is open (e.g. over inventories). Off by default so it stays a gameplay overlay and does not cover menus.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudAli: Which screen corner the HUD is anchored to.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudOff: Horizontal offset in pixels from the aligned corner.
Vertical offset in pixels from the aligned corner.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudSca: Scale factor for the HUD text and icons.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudMax: Maximum number of item rows shown in the HUD. 0 = unlimited (show the whole list).
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudHid: Hide materials whose inventory and tracked-container supply meets the selected required amount.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudOnl: Hide materials with no blocks left to place in the focused placement.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudSho: Show a header line with the schematic name and totals.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudBac: Draw a translucent background behind the HUD.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudSho: Draw the item icon next to each row.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudCon: Master switch for all tracked-container labels, highlights and peek overlays. Hidden containers remain marked and still count materials.
Float a label above nearby marked containers listing their most-plentiful items.
Use a narrow vertical list or the former multi-column layout above marked containers.
Maximum item rows shown per in-world container label; additional rows are summarized in the header.
logisticmatica.config.label_layout.verti: One narrow list that grows upward from the container.
logisticmatica.config.label_layout.colum: Wrap the item list into columns of ten rows.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudCon: When looking at a marked container, show an inventory panel of its contents (from the cache, so it works even closed or far away).
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudLab: Draw the floating container labels through walls. Off means they are hidden behind blocks.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudOut: Draw the marked-container outline through walls. Off means it is hidden behind blocks.
Fill marked containers with a translucent colour, not just an outline, for a more solid highlight.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudPee: Which screen corner the container-peek panel is anchored to. The default is bottom right; move it clear of other overlays as needed.
Horizontal offset in pixels of the peek panel from its corner.
Vertical offset in pixels of the peek panel from its corner.
logisticmatica.config.colors.comment.col: Color of the normal HUD text.
Color of the HUD header line.
Color used for items that are fully available.
Color used for the still-missing amount.
Color of the HUD background, alpha included.
logisticmatica.config.hotkeys.comment.op: Opens the Logisticmatica hub menu - one place to reach every feature.
Opens the Logisticmatica material list screen.
logisticmatica.config.hotkeys.comment.to: Toggles the material HUD on and off.
Downloads the server version, loads its placement and makes that exact placement the source for Logisticmatica's material tools.
logisticmatica.gui.share.focus.descripti: Use this loaded placement for the material list, HUD, containers and substitutions.
logisticmatica.gui.share.focused.descrip: This exact placement currently drives Logisticmatica's material tools.
Open Litematica's normal placement settings. Read-only shared placements remain locked; local rendering controls still work.
logisticmatica.gui.share.status.placemen: The normal Litematica Placement Edit menu is available. Server-authorized placement changes are synchronized with the shared project.
You may open Litematica's normal Placement Edit menu and change local rendering. Shared actions not granted by your project role remain protected.
logisticmatica.gui.share.members: Members (click a role to change it)
logisticmatica.gui.share.confirm_delete: Click again to end sharing and keep a local placement
logisticmatica.gui.share.confirm_delete_: Click again to delete the server project
logisticmatica.gui.share.delete_admin.de: Administratively removes the server project and unloads it for every client.
logisticmatica.gui.share.end_sharing.des: Removes the server project for everyone. Your current placement, schematic state and container marks stay available locally.
logisticmatica.gui.share.leave.descripti: Removes this server project and its loaded placement from your client.
logisticmatica.share.notice.server_missi: This server does not have Logisticmatica installed. Sharing is unavailable; all local client features still work.
logisticmatica.share.notice.preparing_en: Saving the latest server containers locally before sharing ends...
logisticmatica.share.notice.sharing_ende: Sharing ended. Your placement and container marks are now local.
logisticmatica.share.notice.containers_m: %s local container(s) moved to the server project.
%s of %s containers moved to the server project; rejected marks remain local.
logisticmatica.share.notice.invited: You received a Logisticmatica project invitation.
logisticmatica.share.notice.saved_other_: %s was downloaded and will load in its project dimension.
logisticmatica.share.error.no_server: This server does not support Logisticmatica sharing.
logisticmatica.share.error.protocol: Client and server use incompatible Logisticmatica sharing protocols.
logisticmatica.share.error.invalid_reque: The server rejected an invalid sharing request.
logisticmatica.share.error.invalid_respo: The server sent an invalid sharing response.
logisticmatica.share.error.permissions: You do not have permission for that project action.
logisticmatica.share.error.stale: The project changed meanwhile; its latest state was loaded.
logisticmatica.share.error.project_limit: You have reached the shared-project limit.
logisticmatica.share.error.player_offlin: That player must be online to receive an invitation.
logisticmatica.share.error.owner_member: The project owner cannot be invited as a member.
logisticmatica.share.error.cannot_leave: The owner cannot leave; end sharing instead.
logisticmatica.share.error.container_ran: The container must be in your current dimension and within eight blocks.
logisticmatica.share.error.container_lim: This project has reached its container limit.
logisticmatica.share.error.container_upl: This schematic has %s marked containers, but the safe server limit is %s. No project was created.
logisticmatica.share.error.not_container: The server could not read a container at that position.
logisticmatica.share.error.unsaved_schem: The selected placement has no readable .litematic file.
logisticmatica.share.error.schematic_too: The schematic exceeds the server's transfer limit.
logisticmatica.share.error.read_schemati: The schematic file could not be read.
logisticmatica.share.error.load_schemati: The downloaded schematic could not be loaded.
logisticmatica.share.error.project_paylo: The schematic and its container metadata exceed the server transfer limit.
logisticmatica.share.error.server_projec: This server has reached its shared-project limit.
logisticmatica.share.error.member_limit: This project has reached its member limit.
logisticmatica.share.error.container_bou: That container already belongs to another shared project.
logisticmatica.share.error.container_ite: That container has too many distinct item types to share.
logisticmatica.gui.share.choose_placemen: Open all loaded Litematica placements; the currently selected placement is marked with a star.
logisticmatica.gui.share.use_selected.ho: Immediately use Litematica's currently selected placement.
logisticmatica.gui.share.help.descriptio: Explain file actions, role presets, individual permissions and public access modes.
logisticmatica.gui.share.download.descri: Downloads the authoritative server version and loads or refreshes its local shared placement.
logisticmatica.gui.share.replace.descrip: Choose any local placement as the new schematic source. Position, rotation, members, permissions and containers stay unchanged.
logisticmatica.gui.share.no_project_acce: This server placement is listed, but its schematic requires access.
logisticmatica.gui.share.access.descript: Cycle who may use this project without becoming a member.
logisticmatica.gui.share.request_pending: Your access request is waiting for approval
Ask the project managers for the selected role.
logisticmatica.gui.share.request_role.vi: Logisticmatica read-only: view, download, focus and inspect the project. Physical building and container use still follow server or claim rules.
logisticmatica.gui.share.request_role.bu: All Viewer rights plus add, remove and refresh shared tracked-container marks. This does not grant access to physical containers.
logisticmatica.gui.share.request_role.ed: All Supplier rights plus move the shared placement, replace its schematic, edit substitutions and update the project status.
logisticmatica.gui.share.request_role.ma: All Editor rights plus invitations, access requests, member permissions and public access. Ending sharing stays Owner-only.
logisticmatica.gui.share.choose_player.d: Open a searchable list of all currently online players.
logisticmatica.gui.share.role.descriptio: Cycle the requested role; exact capabilities are shown in Sharing Help.
logisticmatica.gui.share.help.world_cont: Logisticmatica roles only control shared project data. Placing or breaking blocks and opening or filling containers are still allowed or denied by the Minecraft server, protection mods and claim plugins.
logisticmatica.gui.share.role.viewer.des: Logisticmatica read-only: view, download, focus and inspect the shared project. This role does not prevent physical building or filling containers when the server allows it.
logisticmatica.gui.share.role.builder.de: Viewer plus add, remove and refresh shared tracked-container marks. This role does not grant or revoke access to physical containers.
logisticmatica.gui.share.role.editor.des: Supplier plus move the shared placement, replace its schematic, edit substitutions and update the project status.
logisticmatica.gui.share.role.manager.de: Editor plus invite players, approve access requests and manage roles, individual permissions and public access.
logisticmatica.gui.share.role.owner.desc: Full Logisticmatica control, including public access and ending server sharing. World access still follows server rules.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.view: View project data and download, reload, focus or inspect the shared schematic; no shared project state can be changed.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.move: Synchronize a changed shared origin, rotation or mirror state; it does not control who may place blocks in the world.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.upda: Replace the shared schematic contents while preserving placement and project data.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.subs: Add, change and remove shared block substitutions.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.mana: Add, remove and refresh shared tracked-container marks; physical opening and filling still follow server rules.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.invi: Invite online players and cancel pending invitations.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.mana: Approve access requests and change member permissions.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.dele: End server sharing for everyone while the owner keeps a local placement and container marks.
logisticmatica.gui.share.access.request_: Everyone sees the project entry, but only invited or approved members can download it.
logisticmatica.gui.share.access.public_v: Everyone may view and download the project without joining it.
logisticmatica.gui.share.access.public_s: Everyone may view the project and manage its shared material containers.
logisticmatica.gui.share.access.public_e: Everyone may view, move and update the project, substitutions and containers.
logisticmatica.share.notice.access_appro: Your access request for %s was approved.
logisticmatica.share.notice.access_decli: Your access request for %s was declined.
logisticmatica.share.error.already_has_a: You already have project access or a pending invitation.
logisticmatica.share.error.pending_invit: Respond to the pending invitation before requesting another role.
logisticmatica.share.error.no_access_req: That player has no pending access request.
Open one canonical list of server projects, local placements and local schematics.
logisticmatica.gui.share.notifications.d: Choose which concrete activity messages you receive for this project.
logisticmatica.gui.notifications.hint: These preferences are local to this client and saved separately for this server.
logisticmatica.gui.notifications.placeme: Origin, dimension, rotation and mirror updates.
logisticmatica.gui.notifications.schemat: A new authoritative schematic file replaces the current project source.
logisticmatica.gui.notifications.substit: Shared block substitution rules were added, changed or removed.
logisticmatica.gui.notifications.contain: Tracked server containers were added or removed.
Exact added and removed items in tracked containers. Hidden by default because the material list already updates live.
Public mode, roles, invitations or access decisions changed.
logisticmatica.share.activity.container_: %s container contents updated in %s container(s). Added: %s. Removed: %s.
logisticmatica.share.activity.access: %s members, roles or public access changed.
logisticmatica.share.error.already_share: This placement already belongs to a server project. Export a local copy first if you need an independent schematic.
logisticmatica.gui.share.local_copy.desc: Saves an independent copy in your schematics folder. The copy is not linked to the server and may be shared as a new project.
logisticmatica.share.error.local_copy_ex: The local schematic copy could not be saved.
logisticmatica.share.error.apply_respons: The server response was valid, but the local project state could not be applied. Open Projects and press Refresh.
logisticmatica.share.error.end_sharing_l: Sharing ended on the server, but the placement could not be fully converted to a local project. It remains loaded; check the log before unloading it.
logisticmatica.share.error.container_glo: The server safety limit for tracked containers has been reached.
logisticmatica.gui.material.setting.sort: Choose the primary sort used by both this menu and the in-game material HUD.
logisticmatica.gui.material.setting.orde: Switch between ascending and descending order.
logisticmatica.gui.material.setting.amou: Compare storage against total schematic requirements or only blocks still missing in the world.
logisticmatica.gui.material.setting.hide: Show or hide materials with no blocks left to place. This setting is independent from the supply filter.
Show or hide materials whose available inventory and tracked-container count meets the selected required amount. Items with no blocks left are controlled by the already-built setting.
logisticmatica.gui.material.setting.icon: Show item icons in the menu and HUD rows.
logisticmatica.gui.material.setting.head: HUD header: %s
Show the schematic name, build totals and shared project status in the HUD.
logisticmatica.gui.material.setting.in_g: Also render the material HUD over open screens.
logisticmatica.config.material_sort.name: Item name
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudMat: Sort key shared by Logisticmatica's material screen and HUD.
Show higher values, or names from Z to A, first.
Use total schematic requirements or only blocks still missing in the world.
logisticmatica.message.container.finding: Flashing the outline of %s at %s, %s, %s for 15 seconds.
logisticmatica.gui.share.change_status.d: Cycle the server-authoritative phase shown to everyone. Hover the status for its current meaning.
logisticmatica.project.status.planning.d: Scope, design or build approach is still being planned.
logisticmatica.project.status.collecting: Materials are currently being collected and supplied.
logisticmatica.project.status.ready_to_b: Material preparation is complete enough for construction to start.
logisticmatica.project.status.paused.des: Work is intentionally paused; check with the project team before continuing.
logisticmatica.project.status.blocked.de: Do not continue yet: an issue or dependency must be resolved first.
logisticmatica.gui.share.permission.upda: Change the shared workflow phase visible in Projects, project details and the focused material HUD.
The shared workflow phase changed, for example from collecting materials to building or blocked.
logisticmatica.gui.share.roles_world_not: These permissions affect Logisticmatica project data, not building or container access in the Minecraft world.
